name: Digital twin
short_description: A maintained digital representation of a physical resource, its relationships and its operating conditions, kept up to date from observations.

evidence.quote: If you're building a digital twin, build it right from the start.
A digital twin can represent the relevant assets and their changing states
A digital twin addresses a related but different need.
